samples.summary: Error envelope still diverges from the §9 spec the diff just amended: doc says "a single JSON line on stderr" with a `command` field, implementation pretty-prints multi-line and omits `command`
samples.evidence: docs/design/cli.md:930-935 (as edited by this change) states: Errors: a single JSON line on stderr with shape `{"error":{"code":"…","message":"…","command":"docs.content"}}`. `outputError` emits `JSON.stringify({error:{code,message}}, null, 2)` — pretty-printed across many lines and with no `command` key. The task's lessons file explicitly parks the `command` gap as out of scope (docs/tasks/active/20260806-cli-quiet-preserves-body-lessons.md:22-24), but the change edits precisely this bullet and could have reconciled the wording (e.g. drop "single JSON line") so the doc stops describing something the code does not do.

samples.summary: `sheets export` writes its "Exported to X" progress notice to stdout, contradicting the §9 convention this change reinforces (notices are display output, body is stdout)
samples.evidence: `console.log(`Exported to ${file}`)` — a progress notice on stdout. Every other notice in the CLI (output/binary.ts:39, slides/content.ts:96,105, notes/content.ts:85) goes to stderr. The whole premise of the fix is that stdout carries only the redirectable body; this one site still mixes a notice into it. Untouched by the diff apart from the adjacent `outputError` call, and arguably beyond the stated non-goals, so minor.
